image_description: A dramatic coastal landscape featuring towering, dark vertical rock cliffs rising from a turbulent ocean. The cliffs exhibit rugged, weathered textures with visible stratification and erosion patterns. Green vegetation covers the flat tops of the cliffs and clings to some ledges. A narrow path or walkway is carved into the side of the foreground cliff. In the distance, rolling green hills meet the horizon under a bright sky.
